automatic_result.automatic_boundary: The immutable runtime report contains no semantic ARRIVED terminal event. Its automatic status is not rewritten by the later operator observation.
automatic_result.terminal_health_detail: Robot 0 retained fresh local sensing, odometry, SLAM, occupancy, alignment and platform checks, but graph_ready was false because tiny_nav_poi_subscriber was absent.
automatic_result.time_ordering_boundary: The archived machine data cannot independently establish the exact ordering between the operator-observed physical arrival and the final Robot 0 health rejection.

metrics.standard_spl_status: official_operator_provided_approximate_independent_shortest_feasible_path; bounded formula saturates at 1.0 because recorded P is below approximate L

behavior: Both robots made measured progress across the long-range collaborative exploration run.
Robot 1 accumulated 11.606679 m of path and received the frozen plant semantic region in round 4; the onsite operator confirmed that it ultimately reached the target.
Robot 0 accumulated 9.037490 m of path while exploring a separate frontier.
The final machine-side safety transition was a global HOLD after Robot 0 reported HEALTH_NOT_READY; both robots confirmed zero velocity.
